notes: I found the main formula fits all 19 non-special points exactly: `y = 1.3x³ + 2.3x² - 1.6x - 48.6`. The point x=100 is an outlier (7772.9 vs expected ~1.32M), indicating a special region around 100. With only one data point there, I guessed the region is [90,110] with a quadratic `0.77729·x²` (marked uncertain) — this needs verification with more probes.
